what: executing a boss ruling's literal wording installed a mark-symmetry defect
defect: a PE mark-type claim the arm binds to a verse carrying no mark

fault: orchestrator - the literal ruling text was ordered without being checked against the arm

Nothing in the process had a step where an ordered sentence was tested against the arms before an author was told to write it.
